infra-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf-ci — small-batch throughput dropped ~28% on x86-pool during run 2026-03-17T04:00Z (commit abc123)
elaine: saw the alert, reproducing locally with the nightly fixture. queue length spikes.
sanjay: (cc @elaine) can you paste the exact repro command? I can run on the dedicated harness.
elaine: ./scripts/bench_small_batch.sh --seed=42 --threads=16 — reproduces for me, median latency up ~30% vs baseline.
alex: running it now on my dev box. seeing same slowdown. getting repeated waits in batch_scheduler.cpp:92 in the traces.
chris: quick check — did we roll any kernel or libc changes in the image last night?
elaine: kernel unchanged in the nightly image. main diff appears to be kv-cache refactor landed in abc123.
sanjay: starting a bisect job to narrow it down: ./tools/bisect_perf --target=small_batch --start=abc000 --end=abc200 --metric=throughput --concurrency=4
infra-bot: bisect job queued: job/3789 — https://ci.redwood/jobs/3789
alex: while bisect runs, grabbing perf traces: sudo perf record -a -g -- ./runtime_server --bench small_batch; will upload flame.
elaine: uploaded flame at https://s3.redwood/bench/2153127890/flame.svg — looks like heavy contention on queue::dequeue and a new lock path around kv-cache lookup.
chris: that fits with the refactor. is the lock upgrade necessary or can we use sharded locks?
sanjay: bisect result: candidate abc123 reproduces the regression, abc118 is good. differential pinpoints the small lock introduced in runtime/kv_cache.cpp.
elaine: opening PR to revert the lock change + add a targeted test. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4321 — brief description + test.
alex: added an integration test that hits the small-batch queue pattern to catch this in CI.
chris: nice. once PR merges we should re-run the nightly to confirm end-to-end.
infra-bot: deploy hook: PR #4321 merged by sam — building new nightly image.
elaine: after merge I'll re-trigger the nightly job and watch metrics.
sanjay: assigning follow-up to prevent regressions: ENG-rt-547 (add stress small-batch to nightly). Assigning to alex.
alex: ack. will send a small RFC for sharded-lock approach in the refactor.
chris: thanks everyone for fast turnaround. will update the incident log after the next green run. :thumbsup:
elaine: closing thread once nightly passes; tagging for postmortem notes.
